definitions.explanation: A video game genre in which players control characters in close combat against each other. An abbreviation of 格闘ゲーム.

examples.japanese: {格|かく}ゲーで{対戦|たいせん}しよう。
examples.english: Let's play a fighting game against each other.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}から{格|かく}ゲーが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I've liked fighting games since I was a kid.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{格|かく}ゲーの{大会|たいかい}はeスポーツとして{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{注目|ちゅうもく}されている。
examples.english: Recent fighting game tournaments are attracting attention worldwide as e-sports.

notes:
USAGE:
Abbreviation of {格闘|かくとう}ゲーム. Very common in gaming culture and everyday conversation. Japan has a strong fighting game tradition with franchises like Street Fighter, Tekken, and Guilty Gear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格|かく}ゲーをやる (to play a fighting game)
- {格|かく}ゲーの{大会|たいかい} (fighting game tournament)
- {格|かく}ゲープレイヤー (fighting game player)

FULL FORM:
- {格闘|かくとう}ゲーム (fighting game, unabbreviated)
